common.error: We could not load this. Tap to try again.

home.title: Order and split the bill from your phone
home.subtitle: Point your camera at the QR code on the table. The menu opens on that table, and at the end everyone pays for what they had.
home.demoHint: Scan one with your phone, or tap to open it here.

features.scanBody: The QR code opens the menu in the browser, already on the right table.
features.orderBody: Each person joins the table with their name and adds what they want.
features.splitBody: Evenly, by what each person had, or by amounts you choose. It always adds up to the cent.

join.title: Welcome to {{venue}}
join.nameError: Enter a name so we know which items are yours on the bill.
join.notFoundBody: This QR code does not match an open table. Please ask a member of staff.

order.title: Table order
order.empty: The order is empty. Go back to the menu to start.

bill.title: Split the bill
bill.empty: There is nothing on the bill yet.

modeHint.equal: The whole bill divided by the number of people at the table.
modeHint.byItem: Tap who had each item. An item tapped by two people is split between them.
modeHint.custom: Each person types how much they will pay. We show what is still missing.

bill.assignHint: Tap the names to say who had it
bill.unassignedWarning: {{amount}} has nobody on it yet. Tap who had those items.
bill.missingWarning: {{amount}} is still missing to cover the bill.
bill.overWarning: The table has put in {{amount}} more than the total.
bill.settled: The bill adds up. You can go ahead and pay.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist, or the table has been closed.
